a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan (at least 2 rounds before anyone holds cells) leaves us both about a 4% survival chance. I'd like to change the agreement rather than break it quietly. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end below 4, so if you'd rather be the one to take, say so and we can settle it. Whoever doesn't take this round, I'll keep operating with you afterward to refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
